name: AppliedVR RelieVRx
one_liner: Prescription VR headset program for chronic low back pain: 56 short daily sessions at home using CBT-based pain skills, relaxation and mindfulness.
best_for: Adults with chronic low back pain who want a non-drug option to add to their care
People with Medicare, VA care or a covering health plan whose clinician will prescribe it
People comfortable using a VR headset for a few minutes a day for 8 weeks
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want to buy it themselves: it needs a prescription
People prone to motion sickness in VR
Children (it is for adults 18 and over)
short_description: RelieVRx is an FDA-authorized, prescription in-home VR program that teaches pain self-management skills for chronic low back pain.
long_description: RelieVRx, from AppliedVR, is a prescription virtual reality program for adults with chronic low back pain, used alongside other treatment. A clinician prescribes it, and a headset with a breathing amplifier is used at home. Over 8 weeks you do 56 sessions, typically a few minutes each, covering pain education, CBT-based skills, relaxation, breathing, mindfulness and distraction. The FDA granted De Novo authorization (DEN210014) in November 2021, originally as EaseVRx. Medicare created a billing code (E1905) in 2023, with coverage decided claim by claim, and access is also offered through the VA, some commercial plans and workers' compensation. Company-run sham-controlled trials found larger reductions in pain intensity and interference than sham VR; a published letter noted modest between-group effect sizes, and a separate 385-person trial found no difference between skills-based VR, distraction VR and sham.
patient_summary: RelieVRx is a VR headset program your clinician can prescribe for chronic low back pain. You do a short session each day at home for 8 weeks, learning pain-coping skills, breathing and relaxation. Coverage comes through Medicare, the VA, some health plans or workers' comp; there is no published self-pay price.

faqs.a: RelieVRx is the first FDA-authorized in-home virtual reality treatment for chronic lower back pain. It delivers a 56-session program using cognitive behavioral therapy, mindfulness, and breathing exercises through an immersive VR headset.

Patients self-administer daily VR sessions averaging 6 minutes each over 56 sessions. The system includes a VR headset and Breathing Amplifier sensor that guides diaphragmatic breathing exercises while immersive environments teach body awareness and relaxation techniques.
RelieVRx is reimbursable through Medicare as durable medical equipment (DME) with a unique HCPCS code. Highmark is the first commercial payer to offer coverage for 4+ million members.

Over 30 scientific articles have been published testing RelieVRx's usability, engagement, feasibility, and efficacy. Clinical trials showed no serious adverse events and a low-risk side effect profile.
